notes.title: Game Update 12/06
notes.content:
Hi Everyone!

Thank you all!
We are very happy to know that so many have enjoyed our game, however we have also heard of a bugg thats been bothering you and thats why we made this update!

 - Tutorial fixed. 
You cannot get "softlocked" in the tutorial anymore by buying the wrong items in the catalogue. We have limited it to the items Grandpa mentions.

- Voiceline removed. 
Since the only thing you will buy in the tutorial are pots and the potato thrower we have removed the voiceline about upgrade sprays and made it unavailable in the tutorial.

Once again big thanks to everyone for playing and enjoying our game! 
Have a Wonderful Summer!
Our best wishes to all of you!
